title: Introducing GPT-5 for developers
summary: Introducing GPT-5 in our API platform—offering high reasoning performance, new controls for devs, and best-in-class results on real coding tasks.
body: Introducing GPT-5 in our API platform—offering high reasoning performance, new controls for devs, and best-in-class results on real coding tasks.
summaryZh: OpenAI在API平台正式推出GPT-5，提供了高推理性能、面向开发者的全新控制选项，并在真实编码任务中展现了卓越的基准和应用表现。原始信息显示：Introducing GPT-5 in our API platform—offering high reasoning performance, new controls for devs, and best-in-class results on real coding tasks.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Introducing GPT-5 for developers”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI发布了全新旗舰模型GPT-5及对应的API支持，显著提升了推理和编码能力，是行业重要里程碑。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
